_provenance.packing: LeftRight: right (low 128 bits) = currency0 (ETH, the reconciliation target); left (high 128 bits) = currency1 (USDC)
_provenance.returndata_synthesis_note: 10-RESEARCH records only the decoded currency0 X64 accumulator, not the full 64-byte eth_call returndata. Each reading's `result` is therefore synthesised by placing the recorded value in the currency0 (right) 128-bit slot with currency1 (left) = 0. The decoded `expected_currency0_x64` is the load-bearing golden value; the invariants below hold on the recorded accumulators regardless of synthesis.
